tiling.note: seam check on the stored PNGs, per file and per axis: wrap = mean abs difference between the first and last pixel row/column (the pair that touches when the tile repeats), inner = mean abs difference between neighbouring pixels over the tile; pass when wrap / inner <= 1.25. Worst ratio over 3 files and 2 axes: 1.0076.
